goal: Protect wallet users from compromised or buggy external signers that tamper with transaction details
Reject external signer responses that use unsafe sighash types or modify outputs and fees
Enable automated functional testing of misbehaving hardware signer responses
agreement: Strong support with all concerns resolved
Verified rejection of unsafe sighashes and finalized inputs across test combiners (fametrano)
Verified mock signer catches simulated hardware wallet misbehavior (vicjuma)
Safety objection on finalized inputs bypassing checks resolved with new rejection logic (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it prevents potential fund loss or output tampering when using external signers
Protects users against compromised hardware devices or bridge software modifying transactions
Eliminates blind trust in signer responses that could divert funds to fees or third parties
